exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e1: Competitive wedge and surplus integration close exactly; before/after surplus losses equal receipts plus excess burden. Positive-trade endpoint stated.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e2: Monopoly profit globally strictly concave; social surplus integrand uses marginal benefit minus real cost, not marginal profit. Existing distortion changes additional loss.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e3: Only ethical weights change; normalized weighted objective globally optimized and receipts distinguished from welfare.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e4: Both IC bounds, budget, utilities and truthful tie computed. Consumption-domain endpoint and restricted menu scope explicit.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e5: All individual boundary best responses and unique zero contribution equilibrium derived; positive joint marginal benefit yields interior efficient provision.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e6: Fixed private lump-sum bills and contribution subsidy produce stated equilibrium. Subsidy spending and tax bills cancel, actual final payments fund goods and both utility gains positive.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e7: Zero-cost effort/full-insurance indifference requires explicit selection to support effort-based premium; no-effort-priced contract is comparison, not robust same-premium implementation.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e8: All high-effort contracts below IC cap ranked by monotonic utility. Full no-effort insurance wins at increased cost; two-regime comparison disproves universal partial-coverage claim.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e9: Counterfactual fixed in conditional sensitivity; revenue transformation and omitted covariance/uncertainty identified. Positive receipts do not prove welfare.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e10: Predetermined assignment, sorting, simultaneous rules, dated outcomes and fiscal interpretation all specified; concrete observed stop condition prevents automatic RD claim.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e11: Transfer and collection goods separated; stated weighted local welfare differs from unweighted resource change and Pareto improvement.
exact_prompt_review.v15-c01-e12: Common population, objective, dated budget and incentives required before aggregation of distinct cases. Evidence/administrative reserve plan and prospective revision rule supplied.

full_proof_review.incidence: Implicit function derivative and elasticity units checked; surplus accounting restricted to competitive/quasilinear/no-preexisting-wedge domain. Monopoly exercise explicitly repairs that baseline.
full_proof_review.linear_tax: Private fixed-transfer labor optimum and aggregate funding derived. Global H<A quadratic optimum and H>=A boundary proof checked including H>2A.
full_proof_review.menu: Both type comparisons, balanced weak-IC allocation and strict perturbation proved; no unprovided participation or off-menu optimality claim.
full_proof_review.public_goods: Weighted planner FOCs yield summed MRS; concavity and boundary conditions establish all stated optima. Voluntary contribution uniqueness and enforced lump-sum funding explicit.
full_proof_review.insurance: Fixed-premium unilateral deviations essential. IC cap and monotone within-regime optimum plus Jensen no-effort maximum prove global result within deterministic uniform contracts. Effort tie, continuum pooling, positive consumption, excluded random/mixed/menu scope explicit.
full_proof_review.evidence: Level parallel trend counterfactual, aggregate elasticity scope and mechanical/behavioral receipt decomposition checked. Causal/statistical assumptions and welfare weights remain separate.
